summary.text: Jason Dawkins is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 179 since December 1, 2014 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously worked as a senior legislative aide to a Philadelphia City Council member.

paragraphs.text: Jason Dawkins's professional experience includes working as senior legislative aide to Philadelphia City Councilwoman Maria D. Quinones Sanchez and as recreation liaison and special projects director for the 7th Council District.
He took office in the state House in December 2014.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Labor and Industry Committee.
